raw_comment:
- After looking at the graph, I noticed that exceptional and extreme droughts occur more frequently in the inland areas, specifically toward the middle of the country. 
-After looking at the graph, I wonder why there is a severe drought in certain areas along the coastline, such as Massachusetts, New Jersey, and Delaware, since they are close to water. 
-This relates to me and my community because it is important to know how my community is affected by drought so I can plan accordingly. Based on the graph, my community, Long Island, NY, is moderately affected by drought. 
-A headline for this graph could be "Where did all the water go?!?"
